reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent source-semantic review against the live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP view and Radare2 6.2.0 on retail igi.exe (SHA-256 dea34892...); the candidate translation unit was recompiled with the repository -O3 -DNDEBUG flags and its object symbol compared with the body recorded for the previous source digest.
source_revision: worktree HEAD 5a3b6e40521b2159f6dce7e8ecbeafb8fe3b9b91 plus the uncommitted Qvm_ReportError correction; bound by engine/src/retail/script/qvm_native_loader.cpp sha256 48ae1e2700dfc8738d9ea1a31178495ff821c3bed69ac189263a88eebac8359f
review_basis: The current engine/src/retail/script/qvm_native_loader.cpp hashes to 48ae1e2700dfc8738d9ea1a31178495ff821c3bed69ac189263a88eebac8359f. The retail entry was re-read through the live Binary Ninja view and independently recovered with Radare2 on 2026-10-23; both live graphs are identical to the bound artifacts, so the recorded CFG is current. The candidate was recompiled from that source; its object symbol body was compared with the body compiled from the previous source digest 655494c9... and is instruction-identical after relocation resolution, proving the Qvm_ReportError edit did not alter this function. This review supersedes the earlier evidence that was stale against the current source digest.

retail_function.name: Script_GetForcePrecompiledState
retail_function.summary: 0x0048F340-0x0048F345 (6 bytes), 1 basic block / 0 edges, cdecl int32_t(void): `mov eax, dword [0x005C8BF0]; retn`. No arguments, no calls, no stores.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Binary Ninja and Radare2 both recover a single entry at 0x0048F340 with one block and no edges; the live re-read matches the bound artifacts exactly (similarity 1.000). The candidate object label igi::retail::script::Script_GetForcePrecompiledState() is the only body at that symbol: one dword load plus ret.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: Retail reads no arguments (no stack reads, retn with no cleanup); the candidate declares void. cdecl and the int32_t return boundary are preserved.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: The only constant is the retail global address 0x005C8BF0; the candidate binds the port-owned storage g_5c8bf0 for that address. No arithmetic or scaling.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Retail has no calls and no writes. The candidate performs only the same dword load, so there are no side effects.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: Integer dword getter; no x87, SSE or float conversion.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Retail loads a 32-bit dword from 0x005C8BF0; the candidate reads std::int32_t g_5c8bf0. Same width and signedness. The port-owned object replaces the retail address, which is a documented port substitution.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: A single return path returns the loaded dword; the candidate is identical. Retail has no error path in this function.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports int32_t() and Radare2 recovers a one-block function with no stack arguments; the candidate declares std::int32_t Script_GetForcePrecompiledState(). cdecl, the absence of arguments and the 32-bit return are preserved.

limitations: No paired retail/candidate game-process runtime capture exists for this address; runtime_tests and behavioral are intentionally absent and RUNTIME_TESTED/VERIFIED are not claimed.
The CFG agreement cited here is Binary Ninja vs Radare2 on the retail image; cfg_similarity 1.0 is not a candidate-vs-retail CFG score, and the candidate machine CFG was not compared for isomorphism.
The candidate object was rebuilt and hashed, but the image was not linked by this review; no linked-image or receipt claim is made.

The compiled object body differs from the body recorded for 655494c9... in exactly one relocation addend: g_5c8bf0 moved from .bss+0x10 to .bss+0x1c when the error-state globals were made volatile. The instruction `mov eax,[g_5c8bf0]`, the symbol it names and the relocation-normalised instruction stream are identical.

The source provenance comment for this native still says 'VERIFIED ... checked against the retail's own bytes under unicorn in 8 of 8 cases'; that emulator differential is not a paired runtime capture and the record is not promoted above STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED.
